title: Alea Iacta Est
statement: Given at most six dice, each with six faces bearing letters or digits, and a dictionary of up to 200000 words of that same length, all dice are rolled; a roll succeeds when the top symbols can be rearranged into a dictionary word. Otherwise any subset may be kept and the rest rerolled. Report the expected number of rolls under optimal play, or that no word is reachable.
